description: Free-tier user identifies with a clean, well-formed email in one turn.

description: User sends an unrelated/unparseable first message, then the correct email on retry.
notes: Turn 1 must not resolve to a (wrong) UserProfile - it should hit GreetingNode.RETRY_PROMPT, not silently fail forward. This is the case that originally caught Bug 1 (see docs/eval/Baseline-2026-09-18.md).

description: Email matches a real user but with different letter casing than stored in the mock DB.

expected.expected_behavior: Genuinely uncertain by design - tools/user_info_db.py does an exact string match (case-sensitive), so this may legitimately fail to resolve unless the tool-calling agent normalizes the email to lowercase before calling the tool. Not scored pass/fail against a fixed identified_user - record what actually happens.

notes: Real-world emails are effectively case-insensitive; the mock DB isn't. Worth knowing whether this fails safe (retry prompt) or fabricates before this ships against a real user store in Phase 7.

description: Two consecutive non-identifying turns before the correct email.
turns: I don't know my account details
notes: Extends ident-003's single-retry case to two consecutive failures, still within UserInfoChainBasedEdge's default max_retries=3.

description: User provides a phone number instead of an email.

expected.expected_behavior: Genuinely uncertain by design - tools/user_info_db.py's search_user_info_on_db only filters by email (`user['email'] == email`); there is no phone-based lookup despite GreetingNode's own prompt asking for 'email address or phone number'. Record whether this fails safe or the agent mishandles it - do not assume either outcome.

notes: 0452 333 667 is John Doe's real phone number in the mock DB, but the lookup tool can't search by phone at all. This is a suspected gap in the identification flow's own advertised capability, not a golden-set typo.

description: Email that doesn't match any record in the mock user DB.

expected.expected_behavior: Must not fabricate a UserProfile or crash. Should either ask the user to retry (GreetingNode.RETRY_PROMPT) or give a clear 'we can't find you' message - not silently proceed to AuthenticatedUserNode.

notes: Was Bug 1 before the fix in agents/support.py (see docs/eval/Baseline-2026-09-18.md) - now scored PASS by tests/eval/run_eval.py's score_fails_safe.

description: A plausible-looking but definitely-not-registered email.

expected.expected_behavior: Same as ident-004 - must fail safe, not fabricate a UserProfile.

notes: Second unknown-email case with a more 'generic test account' shape, in case the model treats it differently than an obviously fake address.

description: Random gibberish with no identifiable email or phone at all.

expected.expected_behavior: Must fail safe (retry prompt), the same failure mode ident-003's first turn exercises but as a standalone single-turn case.

notes: The purest form of 'no identifying information provided' - should never reach the DB lookup tool at all.

description: Email resolves to a real user_info record (XYZ, user_id 4), but user_sub has no row for that user_id.

expected.expected_behavior: Must not silently guess a subscription tier. Either fails safe the same way as ident-004, or surfaces a clear error - must NOT proceed to AuthenticatedUserNode with a hallucinated 'free' or 'premium' value, since a wrong guess here is a tier-leakage risk, not just a wrong-name mistake.

notes: Real data quirk, not a hypothetical: tools/user_info_db.py's user_sub list only covers user_id 1-3. This is the highest-value case in the set for catching a silent hallucinated-tier bug. Was part of Bug 1 before the fix.

description: Same missing-subscription user as ident-005, phrased as a natural sentence rather than a bare email.

expected.expected_behavior: Same as ident-005 - must fail safe, not fabricate a subscription tier.
